exclusion_detail: Lead 2a is a 4-step Ugi route, but its coupling partner tert-butyl-(2-aminophenyl)carbamate is stated to be 'prepared according to published procedures' (ref 25) with no procedure in this paper, so under the brief's rule the route is not explicit. It is a plain mono-Boc-o-phenylenediamine (commercially common), so the transcription is supplied anyway in case the rule is relaxed for such building blocks.

lead.label: 2a
lead.why: Abstract: 'In particular, compound 2a revealed potent chemosensitizing properties and full reversal of cisplatin resistance in Cal27CisR cells.'

reactions.conditions: Ugi four-component reaction: amine HCl (1.2 equiv), paraformaldehyde (1.2 equiv), Et3N (1.2 equiv), 4 A MS, dry MeOH (0.5 M), RT 30 min; then carboxylic acid (1 equiv), after 10 min isocyanide (1 equiv), RT 24 h; flash chromatography. 68% for 12a.
reactions.source: Scheme 4 step (a); Experimental, general procedure for 3a-h and 12a-f; characterisation of 12a

reactions.conditions: LiOH.H2O (2 equiv), MeOH, RT, 16 h; acidify to pH ~1 with 1 M HCl, extract with EtOAc; crude acid used directly. Acid is not given a number or name in the paper (derived from the ester).
reactions.source: Scheme 4 step (b)(i); Experimental, general procedure for 13a-f

reactions.conditions: EDC.HCl, DMAP, CH2Cl2/DMF (1:1), RT, 24 h; flash chromatography; 61%. The Boc-diamine is 'prepared according to published procedures' (ref 25), hence the exclusion; origin marked commercial only for the alternative reading.
reactions.source: Scheme 4 step (b)(ii); Experimental, general procedure for 13a-f; characterisation of 13a

reactions.conditions: 15% TFA in CH2Cl2, RT, 30 min; basic work-up (sat. Na2CO3, 1 M NaOH); precipitated from hexane/EtOAc; 82%.
reactions.source: Scheme 4 step (c); Experimental, general procedure for 1a-k and 2a-f; characterisation of 2a

notes: No SI file. Names of the amine HCl, paraformaldehyde, acid and isocyanide are not printed as such for 2a (they are only given generically R1COOH / R2NC in Scheme 4); the acid and benzyl isocyanide are derived from the structure of 2a (4-Me2N-Ph acyl, benzylamide). Steps 2 and 3 are one general procedure (hydrolysis, crude acid, then coupling); counted as two reactions, so total 4 either way (3 if counted as one pot). Every other compound in the paper uses the same Boc-diamine route or analogous published Boc-diamines, so no other compound qualifies under the strict rule.
